subtasks: Place the four eggs from the basket into the egg holder, then close the lid.
Place the last egg from the basket into the empty front-right cup of the open egg holder.
Close the egg holder lid fully over the four loaded eggs, then open both grippers and return both arms to their starting poses.
Lift the front edge of the egg holder lid to reopen the holder so the high rear-right egg can be reseated.
Gently stand the high rear-right egg upright in its own cup so it rests as low as the other three eggs. Keep the lid open until it settles.
Leave the closed egg holder undisturbed. Fully open both grippers and return both arms to their original resting poses.
